risks.risk: Dead/sticky keys or faulty buttons may exist despite seller claim (no test evidence provided).
risks.proof: Video of power-on and a full key sweep (press every key) plus pressing each button/knob; include audio output.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as not fully verified / possible key or button faults.

risks.risk: Sound/speaker/headphone output may crackle or be weak (no audio demo provided).
risks.proof: Short audio recording playing several notes and at least 2–3 different sounds; show speaker output (and headphone output if available).
risks.if_unproven: Price it as unknown sound quality (worst case: crackle/noise possible).

risks.risk: Adapter may be missing or wrong voltage/plug (no adapter photo).
risks.proof: Photo of the exact adapter included with label (voltage/amp) and a video showing the keyboard powering on using it.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as adapter not confirmed / power not guaranteed.

risks.risk: Model/brand mismatch (identity not readable; pricing depends on exact model).
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the brand/model label (back/bottom) and the full control panel.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as a generic used electronic keyboard (worst-case value for unknown model).

risks.risk: Physical damage not visible due to wrap (corners/ports/stand).
risks.proof: Unwrapped close-up photos of corners, keybed edges, speaker area, and ports/power socket; include underside photo.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as possibly cosmetically worn with unverified condition.

proof_requests: Please send a clear photo of the brand/model label (back or bottom) so the exact model can be priced.
Send a short video: power-on + press every key (full sweep) and show all buttons/controls being used.
Send an audio/video demo showing multiple notes/sounds and confirming no crackle (speaker output).
Send a photo of the adapter you said is included (label with voltage/amp) and a video powering the keyboard with it.
response.reason: The seller’s text claim of testing is not supported by any new photo/video evidence, and the current photos still don’t show a readable brand/model or the adapter. Without proof of identity and working condition, the item can’t be priced reliably beyond worst-case assumptions.
